messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@novalabs.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Mar 2028 15:12:03 -0700
Subject: Quick discovery recap — trial fit probe and next step

Hi Alex — thanks again for taking the time today. Short recap from my side and two quick asks at the bottom.

Call highlights:
- Primary use case: low-latency customer support summarization (100–500 reqs/min, 90th pct < 400ms target).
- Data constraints: must remain in-customer VPC for PII, retention policy 30 days.
- Success metric: reduce per-call LLM token cost by ~40% while keeping summary quality >= current baseline.
- Risk signal: current infra uses small-batch CPU inference — scope for GPU-accelerated endpoint with prefix caching.

What I think fits: Redwood Dedicated or Private (VPC) — we can provision a small pilot that mirrors your SLOs and provide a short trial with usage telemetry. I attached high-level discovery notes and a sample config we discussed.

Two asks:
1) Quick fit feedback — does the pilot idea map to what you need? If not, what am I missing?
2) If yes, pick one 30-min slot for a technical sync (we can include an infra engineer). Options this week: Thu 3/3 10:00am PT, Fri 3/4 11:30am PT, Mon 3/7 2:00pm PT.

If it helps, we can also spin up a 2-week trial environment tied to a single VA and a small dataset — no long-term commitment.

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf, redwood-sample-config.json

Thanks — looking forward to your thoughts.

—Camila
